title: Home practical guide and safety card: filtering
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Dissolving, separating and plants (Do All Solids Dissolve? and Allotment)
source: Written for science/y5 lesson 33 (Home practical guide and safety card: filtering (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 33: Separating mixtures: sieving and filtering. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To separate sand from water by filtering
equipment: A funnel (or the top of a plastic bottle)
A coffee filter or kitchen roll
safety: Do not drink the filtered water
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Mix two spoons of sand with a cup of water
Fold the filter and put it in the funnel over the jar
Pour the mixture slowly into the filter
Watch what passes through and what stays behind
Look at the water in the jar: is it clear?
Draw and label your filtering set-up

questions.q: The liquid that passes through a filter is the...
Big question: how would you get rice out of sand?
questions.a: Sieve it: sand falls through, rice stays.
